create_gtn_graph: create a GTN Graph object with initial and final node configuration for pattern recognition
add_node_to_graph: add a node to a GTN graph with optional initial and final state flags
add_arc_to_graph: add an arc between two nodes in a GTN graph with a symbol label
draw_gtn_graph: draw a GTN graph to a PDF file with symbol labels for nodes and arcs
union_gtn_graphs: union multiple GTN graphs into a single combined graph using gtn.union
